integrity: Standalone exact verification requires only Python 3.10+; all finite checks are regenerable from the graph definition. The result has not undergone independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The proof concerns the finite five-regular folded five-cube, not its ten-regular complement or all folded cubes; the character decomposition is rational and the homotopy equivalence is nonequivariant. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Nine three-spheres and the \(4\oplus5\) symmetry module of the folded five-cube
